name: Public review reply desk
why: Replies to each new batch of public reviews, holds risky ones for the owner and flags repeat complaints, as in the weekly local routine.

name: Review reply batch writer
why: Writes a specific public reply to each review and lists the risky ones, matching the reply templates in the review skill.

name: Review reason spotter
why: Ranks why customers choose you from 20 or more reviews, with exact quotes, for profile text and service pages.

name: Testimonial request writer
why: Asks past clients for website testimonials with their permission and without leading them, separate from Google review asks.

name: One-goal marketing plan builder
why: Turns 'more customers' into a number of booked jobs by a date and a calendar of tests, the start of the local 90-day plan.

name: Search ads experiment planner
why: Plans a small, capped search ads test with a stop rule, before or alongside Local Services Ads.

name: Offline ads experiment planner
why: Plans one tracked postcard, flyer or local radio test with costs and a keep, change or stop rule.

name: Direct mail package reviewer
why: Checks a postcard or letter's offer, copy and look before it prints, for seasonal drops to one postcode.

name: Customer event experiment planner
why: Plans an open day, workshop or pick-your-own event as a capped test with an owner and stop rule.
